record.what_it_does: AI meeting recorder that transcribes, summarizes, clips and shares meeting recordings.
record.auth_notes: Every request sends 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' plus a Public-Api-Version header. The support page gives the version as 2025-10-31, while the dev docs example uses 2026-10-01. There are three ways to get a token. (1) A Personal Access Token ('personal' scope) is generated from grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api and never expires. (2) A Workspace Access Token ('workspace' scope, full workspace data) can only be generated by an admin. (3) OAuth2 authorization code, with PKCE supported, at https://grain.com/_/public-api/oauth2/authorize and POST oauth2/token, with refresh tokens. To register an OAuth client you request a Client ID and Secret from Grain manually, and you need at least one redirect URI. Public clients can skip registration by using an HTTPS URL that serves a Client ID Metadata Document as their client_id, in which case PKCE is required. OAuth 'workspace' scope is 'only available to clients verified by Grain'. The MCP server does not accept workspace-scope tokens.
record.access_notes: Grain's API support page says a PAT is 'Available on every plan, including Free'. A WAT needs a Business or Enterprise plan and workspace admin rights. For OAuth, Grain issues the client ID and secret manually, so registration isn't self-serve, but public clients can skip it with a Client ID Metadata Document. Workspace-scope OAuth is limited to clients that Grain has verified. The vendor's own docs override the third-party claim that free plans have no API access.
record.api_breadth_notes: The v2 REST API is at https://api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2, and the endpoints page lists 44 operations. They cover recordings (14: get, list, transcript in json/txt/vtt/srt, download, update, tags, users, teams), clips (3), stories (1), playlists (12), uploads (5), hooks (3: create, list, delete), token-info, users, teams, meeting_types and OAuth token (2). Hook types are recording_, highlight_, story_ and upload_ added/updated/deleted events. The v1 beta API was sunset in September 2026.
record.mcp_notes: Grain hosts an 'Official Grain MCP Server', documented at developers.grain.com/mcp and support.grain.com/en/articles/14811968. Per the support page, it uses OAuth and HTTPS, and developers can also connect with a PAT. Some tools need Business or Enterprise. The endpoint https://api.grain.com/_/mcp (Streamable HTTP) appears in directory listings (mcpservers.org, Merge, Agentman) and in search snippets of developers.grain.com. When I fetched the vendor page, the URL was not in the rendered text. Workspace-scope tokens are rejected by the MCP server.
record.blocker_notes: PATs are self-serve on every plan, including Free, so a toolkit can be built today. The caveat is multi-user OAuth: Grain issues the client ID and secret manually, though Client ID Metadata Document public clients can avoid that step. Workspace-scope OAuth is limited to clients Grain has verified.

evidence.quote: Available on every plan, including Free.
Webhooks let Grain push data to your system when events occur, rather than requiring you to poll for changes.
At least one redirect URI is required to register a new client.
only available to clients verified by Grain
Every request needs a token in the Authorization header and a Public-Api-Version header.
Hooks let Grain notify your server when something happens.
Developers can also connect with a personal access token.
The v1 (beta) API was sunset in September 2026.
